**Author's Note:** The enryolku is intended to be used for villainous NPCs. DMs who allow it for use on PCs are taking their game's balance into their own hands.

---

## Patsy Veils

At 1st level, the enryolku gains false veil as an at will psi-like ability. The enryolku may invest essence in this false veil as though it were a title. The DC to see through the false veil increases, rather than decreases, when essence is invested in it.

At 2nd level the enryolku can apply the title descriptor to their Storm veils when they shape them. However, the enryolku, and not the entitled, makes all decisions regarding the Storm. When shaping a Storm Title, they may shape it onto an object instead of a creature. When an entitled creature or object is killed or destroyed, their Storm Title is unshaped. The enryolku may only have one Storm Title active at a time, increasing to two when they gain the twinveil storm class feature.

This ability replaces shifting storms.

## Vast Weatherproofing

The enryolku's weatherproofing can protect an unlimited number of creatures, but they can choose to remove certain parts of the protection, such as the endure elements effect or the protection from damage, from any creature they wish. Their weatherproofing applies even to Storm Titles shaped onto another creature or object.

This ability alters weatherproofing.

## Distant Titles

The distance at which the enryolku's titles remain active is the same distance as their Storm's radius.

## Growing Blight

The enryolku gains the following storm powers: Channel the Storm and Widened Storm at 3rd level, Expanded Storm at 7th level, and Calamitous Storm at 13th level. At 17th level, the radius of the enryolku's Storm veils increases to 1 mile per level.

This ability replaces the storm powers gained at 3rd, 7th, 13th, and 17th level.
